faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before starting your website development
faq.q1-question: Does 499₾ cover the total cost of website development?
faq.q1-answer: The 499₾ covers full design, development, and launch. It also includes hosting and domain for the first year - we cover those costs. After year one, you continue with those services directly through the provider.
faq.q2-question: What happens after the first year with hosting and domain?
faq.q2-answer: After year one, hosting and domain transfer to your name - typically 150–200₾/year total, paid directly to the provider. We help you set everything up so there's no confusion. No additional costs from our side.
faq.q3-answer: No. There are no hidden monthly fees. You pay once for the build, and the website works independently without mandatory extra costs.
faq.q4-question: How long will it take to deliver the website?
faq.q4-answer: You will receive a fully functional, modern, mobile-responsive website in exactly 7 calendar days.
faq.q5-answer: After the website is finished, you can manage it on your own. If you need help - such as updating information, adding new projects, or making small technical changes - we are happy to assist. Support is optional and starts from 20₾ depending on the type of work.
